mapping_note: RL-422 records that the pinned Lab candidate is incorrectly labeled §10.57.6 and bound to evokeCallback. The candidate's source belongs to §10.58 Evoke Multiple Callbacks; this contract preserves the candidate ID while mapping the tested public API behavior to canonical §10.58.
notes: This bounded HLA_EVOKED public-API witness samples empty-queue minimum waits at 0, 1, and 4 ms and compares accumulated durations; it then checks that a preloaded callback backlog responds differently to 1 ms and 4 ms maximum arguments. A short CPU-bound test-recorder callback provides repeatable work at millisecond scale. The checks establish observable millisecond-scale argument handling, not exact wall-clock scheduling accuracy. They do not establish HLA_IMMEDIATE behavior, Java parity, independent-provider interoperability, or RTI conformance.
